standard_prerequisites.name: Covering of an object of the pro-etale site by limits of affine etale schemes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the proposition on weakly etale morphisms providing such coverings, and the lemma computing finite limits of sections
standard_prerequisites.use: Supply the reduction to the case where the object is a limit V = lim V_i of affine schemes etale over Y, and the description of the left hand side of the map.

core_obligations: Reduce to an affine base and to limits (proof lines 4926-4946): there is a canonical map epsilon^{-1}f_{etale,*}F -> f_proetale,*}epsilon^{-1}F; to show it is an isomorphism one may work Zariski locally on Y, so assume Y affine, in which case every object of Y_proetale has a covering by objects V = lim V_i with V_i affine etale over Y.

Prove part (1) on such an object (proof lines 4946-4954): evaluating the map on V gives a map from the colimit of the sections Gamma(X x_Y V_i, F) to the sections Gamma(X x_Y V, epsilon^*F); the left hand side is described by the finite limit lemma and the right hand side equals the sections of the pullback along the projection by the description of the pullback, so the assertion follows from the computation of the cohomology of a directed colimit.

Prove part (2) (proof lines 4956-4963): arguing in exactly the same manner reduces the claim to the statement that the colimit of the groups H^i_etale(X x_Y V_i, F) maps isomorphically to H^i_etale(X x_Y V, F), which is again the computation of cohomology along a directed colimit.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to an affine base and to objects given by limits of affine etale schemes.
Identify both sides of the comparison map through the description of the pullback and the limit computation for sections.
Repeat the argument verbatim for the higher direct images.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism f, the pro-etale pushforward of the pullback of an etale sheaf of sets (respectively an abelian sheaf) equals the pullback of the etale pushforward, and likewise for the higher direct images (statement lines 4912-4924). The proof (proof lines 4926-4965) reduces to an affine base and to objects that are limits of affine etale schemes, identifies both sides through the description of the pullback, and concludes with the computation of the cohomology of a directed colimit. H2: one reduction used twice with three inputs, written out in full.
